objective: Make one PostgreSQL function the authoritative mutation gate for System game-state events so Northflank HTTP and ChatGPT-through-Neon writes share identical transition, evidence and idempotency enforcement without creating a second mutable owner.

roles_before.artifact: Ron OS and claim-specific live owners own real-world truth; System owns only derived RPG state.
Neon/PostgreSQL system_events append-only ledger is the single mutable owner of derived game state.
Northflank Node API validates action shape/history and inserts directly into system_events.
Node validation plus database uniqueness prevent conflicting idempotency reuse, unverified progression and double rewards.
Every event stores actor/source/source_ref/claim status/idempotency/request hash and remains replayable.
Explicit SYSTEM_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL=1 memory store supports local/CI tests only.
PWA reads the same authenticated System API and never owns game state.
Separate LifeUp MCP bridge remains an optional integration and is outside cloud-core authority.

role_dispositions.destination: Database action gate validates only derived System actions; it cannot promote a System record above Ron OS/live-owner authority.
system_events remains the only mutable owner of derived game state; no parallel state table or ChatGPT-owned ledger is introduced.
A PostgreSQL system_apply_action function becomes the single persistence mutation gate; Northflank calls it instead of direct INSERT, and ChatGPT may invoke the same function through Neon.
HTTP clients still require SYSTEM_BEARER_TOKEN; database access is separately controlled by Neon connection permissions.
system_apply_action atomically enforces idempotency, quest transitions, verified reward basis and one reward per completion; Node/Memory implementation remains a matching defensive contract.
The function writes the same system_events columns and append-only provenance; existing history remains untouched and projections stay rebuildable.
MemoryStore continues using the JS model/validation path only when SYSTEM_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL=1 is explicit.
PWA continues through the Northflank API against the same ledger.

capability_probes.assertion: Existing POST /api/v1/actions create/replay/conflict behavior still returns 201/200/409 and snapshot reads the same ledger.
Calling the database gate directly cannot award progression from a missing, reported or already rewarded completion and cannot complete/cancel a non-active quest.
PWA/API reads and the separate LifeUp bridge remain available and unchanged by the write-gate move.
Existing events remain readable/rebuildable; Git base SHA and Neon migration branch provide rollback/provenance for the gate change.

tests.command: Apply schema to a disposable PostgreSQL/Neon branch and call system_apply_action for create, exact replay, conflicting replay, reported completion and verified-basis reward rules.
tests.expected: PASS: one DB function atomically enforces current action invariants and returns replay metadata.

tests.command: Run system-cloud CI HTTP smoke plus model tests.
tests.expected: PASS: existing API/auth/PWA/idempotency behavior is preserved.

tests.command: Run architecture/continuity guards and existing LifeUp CI.
